newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to struggle goiing above 4,530.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to struggle goiing above 4,530.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will have a difficult time trying to go too far above 4,525-4,530 region on Wednesday, technical analysts said.
Following its impressive 63 point advance on Tuesday it should be no surprise now to see the index struggling to make much headway today, they added.

Some light profit-taking and an absence of too much aggressive buying today will mean the market will step down a gear and yet the medium-term trend is still for share prices to go higher, analysts said.
By 0811 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 3.6 at 4,522.9.
